content:
CoreWeave Inc. (NASDAQ:CRWV) is one of the 10 Stocks Investors Are Dumping.

CoreWeave ended with a lackluster performance on Tuesday, having lost 11.85 percent to close at $42.61 after a session of profit-taking from Monday's stellar gains.

The stock fell alongside the Nasdaq, declining 1.48 percent, as investors took advantage of its 22 percent jump on Monday to pocket gains.

For illustration purposes only. Photo by Brett Sayles on Pexels

The drop was further supported by a series of sales from key executives last Friday, November 20, including its president and chief executive officer Michael Intrator, chief operating officer Sachin Jain, chief financial officer Nitin Agrawal, chief development officer Brannin McBee, and chief strategy officer Brian Venturo, among others. Apart from the disposal, they also acquired additional shares on the same date.

Intrator alone disposed of $581,513 worth of shares involving 13,753 units, while acquiring 23,443 shares through the settlement of vesting restricted stock units. These bring his total ownership to 558,625 shares, alongside 304,764 remaining restricted stock units.

In other news, CoreWeave Inc. (NASDAQ:CRWV) earlier in the week received bullish ratings from two analysts.

Citizens reaffirmed its outperform rating on the stock alongside a price target of $180. The price implied a 322 percent upside potential from its latest closing price, reflecting expectations for continued growth among key industry players as demand for computing capacity continues to outstrip available supply.

Apart from Citizens, the stock also earned a buy recommendation from Freedom Capital Markets, alongside a price target of $151, or a 254 percent upside potential.

chineseContent:
CoreWeave Inc.（纳斯达克股票代码：CRWV）是投资者正在抛售的 10 只股票之一。

CoreWeave 周二表现平淡，在周一大幅上涨后获利了结后，下跌 11.85%，收于 42.61 美元。

该股与纳斯达克指数一起下跌，下跌 1.48%，投资者利用该股周一上涨 22% 的机会获利。

仅用于说明目的。 Pexels 上 Brett Sayles 拍摄的照片

上周五（11 月 20 日）关键高管的一系列抛售进一步支撑了这一跌幅，其中包括总裁兼首席执行官 Michael Intrator、首席运营官 Sachin Jain、首席财务官 Nitin Agrawal、首席开发官 Brannin McBee 和首席战略官 Brian Venturo 等。除了出售之外，他们还在同一天购买了额外的股份。

仅 Intrator 就处置了价值 581,513 美元的股票，涉及 13,753 股，同时通过兑现限制性股票单位收购了 23,443 股。这使得他的总所有权达到 558,625 股，以及剩余的 304,764 股限制性股票单位。

其他消息方面，CoreWeave Inc.（纳斯达克股票代码：CRWV）本周早些时候获得了两位分析师的看涨评级。

Citizens 重申了对该股跑赢大盘的评级，并将目标价定为 180 美元。该价格较最新收盘价有 322% 的上涨潜力，反映出随着计算能力的需求继续超过可用供应，主要行业参与者对持续增长的预期。

除了 Citizens 之外，该股还获得了 Freedom Capital Markets 的买入建议，目标价为 151 美元，即 254% 的上涨潜力。

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Uc09s4vLi1E
